title: Jesus... I Eat Lunch On The Staircase Every Day 🍱
topic: he eats lunch on the office staircase every day and calls it a choice, but really no one ever asked him to join

bible.text: For I was hungry and you gave Me something to eat, I was thirsty and you gave Me something to drink, I was a stranger and you took Me in,

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I eat lunch on the office staircase every day. 🍱

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: The team goes to the food court. Nobody asks. So I stopped waiting to be asked.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You call it a choice. But you rehearsed that line the whole walk up.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: So what? I like the quiet. It's not that deep.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Quiet you chose is rest. Quiet that chose you is loneliness.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You don't need the whole team. Be the one who asks first.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Who at your office eats alone? 👇
